title: Colony and Static
author: Casper Voss
blurb: Noor Eriksen, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
